manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Grab the cylindrical can with smooth surface and the hand-sized can with metallic finish simultaneously, then drop both into the rectangular plasticbox with locking clips.

Task description: Targets are the red-and-yellow cans on either side of the blue rectangular latched plastic box in the image, with shiny silver metal tops. Grasp both cans simultaneously and place them in that box.

Success criteria: Both cans must be inside the blue plastic box with locking clips, each horizontally close to either of its two target placement points. Both grippers must be open and release the cans.

## Execution tips

- Consider grasping the relatively straight cylindrical side wall around the middle of the can, with both pads facing each other. Avoid the rolled top edge and narrowing base to reduce off-center grasping or slipping.
- Make the gripper opening only slightly wider than the can's diameter. Before closing, confirm the fingers are actually on opposite sides of the can rather than merely overlapping in the image without enclosing the body.
- During simultaneous dual-arm grasping, use approach space on either side of the box. Keep can bottoms above its rim when approaching the opening, and maintain space between both cans and grippers to reduce collisions and squeezing.
- Near the target placement location, leave clearance between the two cans and confirm each bottom is fully inside the box rim, avoiding placement on the border or latch.
- Lower the can close to the support surface inside the box before release, while leaving room for the fingers to open. This reduces bouncing, rolling out, or the gripper spreading against the box wall.
